title: DPS registration (pre-hub)
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0 and re-verified field by field against FW 2.1.4 (branch fix/2.1.4, release commit "chore(release): 2.1.4", whose parent is x-nearest-commit). x-source line numbers are from the 1.8.0 generation and are STALE; fields added or changed for 2.1.4 cite functions instead. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: DPS provisioning (a separate broker). `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

registrationId.description: The device's registration id, which is its gateway id. The only key in the payload: no tags and no model id, so DPS enrolment tags cannot originate in firmware.
